title: Thresholds under coordinate partitioning
statement: Let $n,m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ have a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most $k$, let $z\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and let $\pi:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,\ldots,m\}$ be any map. The function $w\mapsto f\bigl((z_iw_{\pi(i)})_{i=1}^n\bigr)$ on $\{-1,1\}^m$ also has a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: f has a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most k
Choice of sign vector z in the n-dimensional cube
Arbitrary map π from the n coordinates to the m coordinates
